comparison_model_unchanged: code/model.py::P4MOrientationNet (Model 2, historical post-hoc formulation, not modified)

group.name: D8
group.note: D4's irrep(1,2) is only 1-dimensional (degenerate) -- established in Phase 1R; D8 is used exclusively, per Stage 7 instruction #5

architecture.block1: R2Conv(k=5,pad=2,bias=False) -> InnerBatchNorm -> ReLU, c1=8 regular-repr fields (64 raw channels)
architecture.pool1: PointwiseAvgPoolAntialiased(sigma=0.66, stride=2) -> spatial resolution H/2 x W/2
architecture.block2: R2Conv(k=5,pad=2,bias=False) -> InnerBatchNorm -> ReLU, c2=8 regular-repr fields (64 raw channels) -- SHARED representation
architecture.q_head: R2Conv(shared_type -> FieldType([D8.irrep(1,2)]), k=3, pad=1, bias=False) -- dense output at H/2 x W/2, NOT globally pooled

q_parameterization.head_tail_convention: theta === theta + pi (verified: Q(theta+pi) == Q(theta) to machine precision)
q_parameterization.S_positivity: guaranteed by construction (Euclidean norm), no additional clamping/abs operation applied

loss.L_class: cross-entropy on per-patch benign/malignant label (reuses code/data_prep.py label parsing, unmodified)
loss.L_Q: masked MSE on (q1,q2) at Stage-4-valid locations only, resolution-matched via 2x2 average pooling with an all-4-valid conservative masking rule
loss.lambda_Q_status: fixed, documented, NOT tuned, NOT pathology-dependent, NOT test-set-dependent

target_masking.source: Stage 4 persisted fields (results_v2/anatomy_targets/stage4_fields/*.npz), validity rules UNCHANGED from docs_v2/phase2_target_spec.md
target_masking.resolution_mismatch_handling: model Q head outputs at H/2 x W/2 (one stride-2 pool in block1); Stage 4 target is at native H x W; downsampled via 2x2 avg-pool for q1/q2, validity mask downsampled via an all-4-valid rule (conservative -- avoids blending valid/invalid pixels into an ambiguous partially-fabricated value)
target_masking.zero_valid_patches: contribute 0 to L_Q and are excluded from the batch average (not treated as a perfect prediction)

reproducibility.dtype: float32 (FP32; mixed precision NOT enabled per Stage 7 instruction #11 -- architecture fits safely in FP32, see memory estimate in reports/STAGE7_AUDIT_REPORT.md)
